Yeroo namoonni tokko tokko karaa irraa jallatan, Haaruun akkana isaaniin jedhe: Rabbiin keessan baay'ee Rahmata Qabeessa, kanaaf ana hordofaa, jecha koos ajajamaa.
t.When he arrived in Madinah, he ordered a: Yeroo inni Madiinaa ga'e, akka masjiidni ijaaramu ajaje. Abbootiin lafa sanaa akkana jedhan: gatii isaa Allaah qofa irraa barbaanna.
t.When he travelled from Makkah, he hid in: Yeroo inni Makkaa irraa imale, michuu isaa wajjin holqa keessa dhokatee akkana jedheen: Hin gaddin, Allaah nu wajjin jira.
t.When he was forty, the first revelation: Yeroo inni umurii afurtamaa ture, wahyiin jalqabaa Holqa Hiraa keessatti isatti dhufe. Malaa'ikni akkana jedhe: Iqra' (Dubbisi)!
t.When it rains, we ask Allah to make the: Yeroo roobni roobu, Allaah akka roobni nuuf gaarii ta'u kadhanna.
t.When one of you sneezes, let him say: Al: Yeroo tokkoon keessan hanxifatu, haa jedhu: Alhamdulillaah (galanni hundi kan Allaah ti).
t.When someone helps us, we thank them wit: Yeroo namni tokko nu gargaaru, du'aa kanaan isa galateeffanna.
t.When the Prophet ﷺ came to Madinah, he o: Yeroo Nabiyyiin ﷺ Madiinaa dhufan, akka masjiidni ijaaramu ajajan.
t.When the flood came, Nuh carried the bel: Yeroo lolaan dhufe, Nuuh mu'minootaa fi bineensota lama lamaan doonii keessatti baate, dooniinis dambalii akka tulluu fakkaatan irra deemte.
t.When they were afraid, what did Allah te: Yeroo isaan sodaatan, Allaah maal isaaniin jedhe?
t.When things are hard, be patient and cal: Yeroo wantoonni ulfaatan, obsii Allaah waami.
t.When we come home, we say Bismillah and: Yeroo gara manaa dhufnu, Bismillaah jennee maatii keenyaaf salaamtaa kennina.
t.When we come out of the bathroom, we ask: Yeroo mana fincaanii keessaa baanu, Allaah akka nuuf dhiisu kadhanna.
t.When we enter the masjid, we ask Allah f: Yeroo masjiida seennu, Allaah rahmata Isaa kadhanna.
t.When we feel angry, we say this and calm: Yeroo aariin nutti dhaga'amu, kana jennee tasgabbaa'na.
t.When we go out, we trust Allah to look a: Yeroo baanu, akka nu eegu Allaatti hirkanna.
t.When we leave the masjid, we ask Allah f: Yeroo masjiida keessaa baanu, Allaah tola Isaa kadhanna.
t.When we make a mistake, we say sorry to: Yeroo dogoggora hojjennu, Allaah dhiifama gaafannee akka nuuf dhiisu kadhanna.
t.When we ride in a car or travel, we say: Yeroo konkolaataa yaabbannu ykn imalu, du'aa Qur'aana irraa kana jenna.
t.When we wake up, we thank Allah for a ne: Yeroo dammaqnu, guyyaa haaraaf Allaah galateeffanna.
t.When you enter the mosque, say: O Allah,: Yeroo masjiida seentu, jedhi: Yaa Allaah, balbala rahmata Keetii naaf bani. Yeroo baatu, jedhi: Yaa Allaah, tola Kee irraa sin kadhadha.
t.When you sneeze, say Alhamdulillah. The: Yeroo hanxifattu, Alhamdulillaah jedhi. Namni si dhaga'e Yarhamukallaah jedha, atis akkana deebisi: Yahdiikumullaahu wa yuslihu baalakum.
t.Where did the first revelation come to t: Wahyiin jalqabaa eessatti Nabiyyiitti ﷺ dhufe?
t.Which dua asks Allah for more knowledge?: Du'aan kam Allaah irraa beekumsa dabalataa kadhata?
t.Which hill did the Prophet ﷺ climb to ca: Nabiyyiin ﷺ namoota Quraysh waamuuf gaara kam ol ba'an?
t.Which name of Allah means the Provider?: Maqaan Allaah kam Kan Rizqii Kennu jechuudha?
t.Which names mean the First and the Last?: Maqaawwan kamtu Isa Jalqabaa fi Isa Dhumaa jechuudha?
t.Which of these is NOT one of the four sa: Kanneen keessaa kamtu ji'oota kabajamoo afran keessaa MITI?
t.Which part do we wash last in wudu?: Wuduu'a keessatti qaama kam dhuma irratti dhiqanna?
t.Which prophet struck the sea with his st: Nabiyyiin kam ulee isaatiin galaana rukute?
t.Which small creature warned the others i: Seenaa kana keessatti uumamni xiqqaan kam warra kaan akeekkachiise?
t.Which surah comes first in the Quran?: Qur'aana keessatti suuraan jalqaba dhuftu kami?
t.Which surah comes last in the Quran?: Qur'aana keessatti suuraan dhuma dhuftu kami?
t.Which surah do we recite in every rak'ah: Raka'aa hunda keessatti suuraa kam qara'anna?
t.Which surah ends with many names of Alla: Suuraan kam maqaawwan Allaah baay'eedhaan xumuramti: Al-Malik, Al-Quddus, As-Salaam...?
t.Which two names come together at the sta: Jalqaba Aayatul Kursii irratti maqaawwan lamaan kamtu waliin dhufu?
t.While he was standing in prayer, the goo: Osoo inni salaataaf dhaabatee jiruu, gammachiisni dhufe: Allaah ilma maqaan isaa Yahyaa jedhamu, maqaa Allaah kanaan dura nama tokkoofuu hin kennin, isaaf ni kenna.
t.Who comforted the Prophet ﷺ after the fi: Wahyii jalqabaa booda Nabiyyiin ﷺ eenyutu tasgabbeesse?
t.Who most deserves our good company?: Hiriyummaa keenya gaarii eenyutu caalaa mirga qaba?
t.Who saw eleven stars, the sun and the mo: Abjuu keessatti urjii kudha tokko, aduu fi ji'a eenyutu arge?
t.Whoever believes in Allah and the Last D: Namni Allaahii fi Guyyaa Dhumaatti amane waan gaarii haa dubbatu ykn haa callisu.
t.Whoever is not merciful will not be show: Namni rahmata hin goone rahmanni hin godhamuuf.
t.Whom did Musa ask Allah to make his help: Muusaan Allaah akka eenyuun gargaaraa isaa godhu kadhate?
t.Years later he returned and entered Makk: Waggoota booda deebi'ee guyyaa Banamuu (Al-Fath) Makkaa seene. Gargaarsii fi injifannoon Allaah dhufe.
t.Yes, even his people knew he was truthfu: Eeyyee, sabni isaallee akka inni dhugaa dubbatu beeku ture.
Eeyyee, kanaaf nyaata keenya ni qoodanna.
t.Yes. Being kind to animals brings reward: Eeyyee. Bineensotaaf gara laafuun mindaa fida.
t.Yes. He forgives those who turn back to: Eeyyee. Warra gara Isaatti deebi'aniif ni dhiisa.
t.Yes: Say Bismillah and eat with your rig: Eeyyee: Bismillaah jedhiitii harka mirgaa keetiin nyaadhu.
t.Young Yusuf saw a dream: eleven stars, t: Yuusuf xiqqaan abjuu arge: urjii kudha tokko, aduu fi ji'a isaaf sujuudan. Abbaa isaa Ya'quubitti hime.
t.Your friend sneezes and says Alhamdulill: Hiriyaan kee hanxifatee Alhamdulillaah jedhe. Ati maal jetta?
t.Your mother, then your mother, then your: Haadha kee, sana booda haadha kee, sana booda haadha kee
t.Yunus left his people and boarded a ship: Yuunus saba isaa dhiisee doonii guutuu ta'e tokko yaabbate.
t.Yunus was brought out onto the shore, an: Yuunus gara qarqara galaanaatti baafame, Allaahis biqiltuu isa irratti biqilche.
t.Zakariya had grown old and his wife had: Zakariyyaan dulloomee ture, haati manaa isaas ijoollee hin qabdu turte. Innis dhoksaan Rabbii isaa waame: Yaa Rabbii koo, Si biraa sanyii gaarii naaf kenni. Ati du'aa hunda ni dhageessa.
t.Zakariya took care of Maryam. Whenever h: Zakariyyaan Maryamiin kunuunsa ture. Yeroo hunda kutaa ishee kan itti sagaddu seenu, nyaata ishee bira argata ture. Innis gaafate: Kun eessaa dhufe? Isheen jette: Allaah biraa ti. Allaah nama fedheef lakkoofsa malee rizqii kenna.
t.Zakariya wondered how this could be, and: Zakariyyaan kun akkamitti akka ta'u dinqisiifate, Allaahis akkana jedhe: Kun naaf salphaa dha. Akka mallattootti, Zakariyyaan halkan sadii mallattoo malee namootatti hin dubbanne, ganamaa fi galgala akka Allaah faarsan isaanitti hime.
